SELECT payment_type, ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.review_id, r.order_id, p.payment_type, r.review_score
  FROM order_reviews r
  JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = r.order_id
) t
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY payment_type
LIMIT 100;
